description:
The account's inbox placement tests, newest first.
When to use: When the user asks about recent or running inbox placement tests.
Parameters: status (optional) — running or finished; createdAfter / createdBefore (optional) — YYYY-MM-DD; page (optional, from 1); pageSize (optional, 1-100, default 25).
CREDITS: Does not spend validation credits.

createdAfter.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime; only tests created at or after it

createdBefore.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime; only tests created at or before it

pageSize.description: Tests per page, 1 to 100 (sent as page_size)

name: list_inbox_placement_tests
title: List inbox placement tests
